Dr. Martinez, patient Aisha Rahman (age 72) presents with: Hip fracture s/p ORIF, post-op day 3, ready for discharge planning. Relevant history: Osteoporosis (on alendronate); Atrial fibrillation (on warfarin, INR 2.3 today); CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Current medications: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR target 2.0-3.0), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, and 2 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please review the discharge medication list for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). She is on warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3 today), alendronate 70mg weekly, and metoprolol 50mg BID. She has CKD stage 3a (eGFR 48). Please assess for drug interactions, renal dosing, and warfarin stability given her recent hip fracture surgery on post-op day 3.
Reviewing discharge medication list for patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503).

Medication review complete for Aisha Rahman (PT-41503). Current medications: Warfarin 5mg daily (INR 2.3, within target), Alendronate 70mg weekly, Metoprolol 50mg BID, Oxycodone 5mg PRN, Docusate 100mg BID. No drug interactions detected. Warfarin stable with therapeutic INR. No renal dosing adjustments required for CKD stage 3a. Safe for discharge from a pharmacy perspective. Awaiting your discharge approval.

Patient Aisha Rahman (PT-41503) cleared for discharge. Please prepare discharge instructions: hip precautions, wound care, weight-bearing status, DVT prophylaxis, medication education (especially warfarin - next INR check in 3-4 days), and arrange follow-up with orthopedics in 2 weeks and primary care in 1 week.

Aisha Rahman (PT-41503) is APPROVED FOR DISCHARGE to home with home health services. Clinical summary: 72yo female s/p ORIF for hip fracture, POD3, hemodynamically stable with therapeutic INR 2.3. Please finalize discharge instructions: reinforce hip precautions, weight-bearing status, wound care, DVT prophylaxis with warfarin monitoring (next INR in 3-4 days), and arrange follow-up appointments with orthopedics in 2 weeks and primary care in 1 week.
